Add point annotations

Source: R/annotation.R
ngs_add_points.Rd

Add point annotations

Usage

ngs_add_points(x, points, ids = NULL, layer = NULL)

Arguments

x

An annotation layer or a scene.

points

The points to add. Either a data frame with x, y and z columns (and optionally an id column), a matrix with three columns or a single numeric vector of length 3.

ids

Optional IDs for the points. If not given (and not in points), the points are numbered consecutively.

layer

If x is a scene: name or position of the annotation layer. Can be omitted if the scene has only one annotation layer.

Value

The modified layer or scene.

Examples

an <- ngs_annotation_layer()
an <- ngs_add_points(an, data.frame(x = 1:3, y = 4:6, z = 7:9))
an <- ngs_add_points(an, c(10, 20, 30))
as.data.frame(an)
#>   id  x  y  z
#> 1  0  1  4  7
#> 2  1  2  5  8
#> 3  2  3  6  9
#> 4  3 10 20 30

sc <- ngs_scene(ngs_image_layer("precomputed://gs://x/em"), an)
sc <- ngs_add_points(sc, c(1, 2, 3))
